title: s3-WGS Protocol for Nuclei Isolation and Tn5 Preparation
author: Andrew Adey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beb3jaqn
materials: Combine the following reagents for a RT-PCR reaction directly to the 96 well plate contained the samples. ddH2O, Q5U Master Mix and 100X SYBR can be made as a mastermix prior to added to wells. PCR primers (S70x (TruSeq i7) and N50x (Nextera i5) we sent last time) to final conc. 500nM 2.5 uL each primer Sample 16.5 ul H2O 3 uL Q5U 25 ul 100X SYBR 0.5uL Total 50 ul for PCR

Concentrate DNA via column clean up Run full pool volume through Qiaquick PCR purification column following manufacturer's protocol. Qiagen QIAquick PCR Purification Kit Protocol by Michael Crone Elute in 50 µL, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 .
Use Tapestation software to quantify DNA from 200-1000bp size. Dilute library to 1nM and prepare for sequencing following Illumina protocols.

Concentrate DNA via column clean up Run full pool volume through Qiaquick PCR purification column following manufacturer's protocol. Qiagen QIAquick PCR Purification Kit Protocol by Michael Crone Elute in 50 µL, 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 .

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Oligonucleotides
steps.instruction: Prepare the iTSM plate and order/prepare oligonucleotides (iTSM, sci_WG, A14_ME_LNA, PCR_i5 primers, and PCR_i7 primers) as specified in s3_oligos.xlsx.

steps.title: Generate and Load Tn5 Enzyme
steps.instruction: Generate and purify pTXB1.Tn5. Load the enzyme with a single oligonucleotide and its mosaic end reverse compliment to a final concentration of equimolar 2.5uM oligonucleotide:mosaic end reverse compliment with 2.5uM Tn5.

steps.title: Construct Nuclei Isolation Buffer (NIB)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50mL of either NIB-Tris or NIB-HEPES using the following components: 500 uL 1M Tris HCl (pH 7.5), 100 uL 5M NaCl, 150 uL 1M MgCl2, 500 uL 10% Igepal, 500 uL 10% Tween, and ddH2O to volume.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Add 2 Pierce Protease Inhibitor Tablets (EDTA-Free) and vortex to dissolve.
Store NIB at 4 °C (stable for 1 month); keep on ice during use.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei from Adherent Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and isolate nuclei using the following procedure:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 million cells in T25 flask the day prior; harvest while subconfluent.
Aspirate media and wash cells with 5 mL ice-cold 1X PBS, then aspirate.
Add 5 mL TrypLE, incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes, and collect cells into a 15mL tube on ice.
Spin down the solution at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL NIB:HEPES and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Repeat the spin down and resuspension for a second wash.
Resuspend cells in 300 µL NIB:HEPES and hold on ice.

steps.title: Quantify and Aliquot Nuclei
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the isolated nuclei and prepare aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10uL of nuclei suspension in 90 µL NIB:HEPES (1:10 dilution).
Count nuclei/uL using a Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20 Automated Cell Counter.
Separate nuclei into aliquots of 1 million nuclei (or up to 3M) and transfer to 5mL tubes.
Add NIB:HEPES to suspend each 1M nuclei aliquot in a total volume of 5 mL.

steps.title: Perform Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Prepare the tagmentation plate and react the nuclei with Tn5 enzyme.

substeps.instruction: Combine 420 µL of 500 nuc/uL solution with 540 µL 2X TD Buffer per 96-well iTSM plate.
Pipette 8uL of this TD Buffer:Nuclei solution into each well.
Add 1uL of 2.5uM uniquely indexed SBS12-U-ME TSM per well (Total volume 9uL: 3.5ul nuclei solution, 1uL TSM, 4.5ul 2X TD Buffer).
Keep the SBS12-U-ME TSM plate, nuclei, and tagmentation plate on ice during preparation.
Incubate at 55 °C for 10 minutes while shaking at 300 rpm.
Place plate on ice for 2 minutes to cool.

steps.title: Pool and Sort Nuclei
steps.instruction: Pool the tagmented nuclei and sort them into a PCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Pool the full plate on ice and add 2 µL of 5mg/mL DAPI.
If chunks are visible, strain the pool through a 40um cell strainer.
Prepare a 96-well plate containing 9 µL of 1X TD Buffer (diluted with ddH2O) per well.
Sort 15 DAPI+ nuclei per well into the 96-well plate using a cell sorter (e.g., Sony SH800S), maintaining the sample chamber and pool at 4 °C.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Perform Gap-Fill and Linear Extension
steps.instruction: Process the sorted nuclei to prepare for PCR.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL 0.1% SDS to each well.
Add 4 µL NPM to each well (must be added step-wise, not pre-combined).
Incubate at 72 °C for 10 minutes for gap-fill, then hold on ice.
Add 1.5 µL A14-LNA_ME (1uM) to a final concentration of 100 nM.
Perform 10 cycles of linear extension: 98 °C (30s), 98 °C (10s), 59 °C (20s), 72 °C (10s). Hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Amplify Libraries via Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the libraries and monitor using SYBR fluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL 1% (v/v) Triton X-100 to quench SDS (10:1 ratio).
Perform real-time PCR (15-17 cycles): 98 °C (30s), 98 °C (10s), 55 °C (20s), 72 °C (30s), measure SYBR fluorescence, 72 °C (10s).
Stop the reaction when fluorescence stops exponential growth; hold at 72 °C for 2 minutes, then hold at 10 °C.

steps.title: Clean and Quantify Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool the PCR products and perform size selection and quantification.

substeps.instruction: Pool 25 uL from each well into a 15mL conical tube.
Perform 1X SPRI bead size selection (selecting for DNA > 200 bp).
Add 50 µL MagPure NGS Binding Beads (room temperature, vortexed 10s), incubate for 5 minutes.
Pellet beads on magnetic rack (approx 2 mins), discard elution.
Wash bead pellet twice with 100 µL 80% ethanol (v/v).
Remove remaining ethanol via brief centrifuge spin and magnetic rack.
Resuspend beads in 31 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, incubate for 5 minutes, pellet on magnetic rack, and collect elution.
Quantify DNA concentration using 1uL sample with Qubit DNA HS kit.
Dilute sample to 2 ng/uL using 10mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and run 2 uL on Agilent Tapestation 4150 (D5000 or D1000).
Load libraries according to Illumina standard concentrations.

steps.title: Fix and Deplete Nuclei (Alternative/Additional)
steps.instruction: Perform fixation and nucleosome depletion on the 5mL nuclei suspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 246 µL 16% formaldehyde (final 0.75%) to the 5mL nuclei suspension.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes on an orbital shaker at 50 rpm.
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and aspirate solution.
Wash pellet with 1 mL NIB:Tris, centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, and aspirate.

Wash pellet with 200 µL 1X NEBuffer 2.1 (prepared by diluting 10X NEBuffer 2.1: 500uL 5M NaCl, 500uL 1M Tris HCl pH 7.5, 500uL 1M MgCl2, 50uL 100ng/uL BSA, 3450uL H2O), centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, and aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 760 µL 1X NEBuffer 2.1.
Add 40 µL 1% SDS (final 0.05%) and incubate at 37 °C for 20 minutes at 300 rpm.
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and aspirate.
Resuspend pellet in 50 µL NIB:Tris (pool replicates here; triturate or use Dounce homogenizer if clumping occurs).
Dilute 5uL of suspension in 45 µL NIB:Tris (1:10) and determine concentration via Hemocytometer or BioRad TC20.
Dilute nuclei to 500 nuclei/uL with NIB:Tris for tagmentation.
